vs
Tofjal Huq and others ------ Plaintiff Appellant-Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 8. Mr Md Azizul Hoque, the learned Advocate appearing for the defendant-respondent-petitioners in the course of argument after placing the judgments of 2 (two) Courts below and deposition of witnesses submits that the trial Court rightly doubted the bainapatra in question on the grounds that the plaintiff claimed in his plaint total 0.57 acres of land but the schedule of bainapatra contained only 0.42 acres of land and PW 3, Abdur Rahman, who stated that only Taka 3,800 was paid as advance money which clearly contradicts the plaintiff's case that the defendant No. 1, executed a bainapatra on receipt of Taka 38,000 out of Taka 47,481 through her husband on 21-4-1980 but the lower appellate Court without adverting all these material findings of the trial Court abruptly reversed the decision of the trial Court by the impugned judgment and decree dated 31-1-2000 which is, in fact, not a proper judgment of reversal ,and, as such, the impugned judgment and decree is liable to be set aside.
